mapper.select:
select * from kng_study_record
order by start_study_time desc, id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}

select coalesce(sum(case when start_study_time >= #{sevenDaysAgo} then 1 else 0 end), 0) num_of7days, count(*) num_oftotal, coalesce(sum(case when study_status = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) num_of_finish from kng_study_record where courseware_id = #{coursewareId}

select coalesce(sum(case when finish_cost_days <= 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) num_in_one_day, coalesce(sum(case when finish_cost_days between 2 and 7 then 1 else 0 end), 0) num_in_one_week, coalesce(sum(case when finish_cost_days between 8 and 30 then 1 else 0 end), 0) num_in_one_mon, coalesce(sum(case when finish_cost_days between 31 and 90 then 1 else 0 end), 0) num_in_three_mon, coalesce(sum(case when finish_cost_days > 90 then 1 else 0 end), 0) num_in_more_thr_mon from kng_study_record where courseware_id = #{coursewareId} and study_status = 1

select dept_id, count(distinct user_id) study_count, count(distinct case when study_status = 1 then user_id end) finish_count from kng_study_record where courseware_id = #{coursewareId} and dept_id is not null
and dept_id in
#{deptId}
group by dept_id

select coalesce(sum(case when start_study_time >= #{sevenDaysAgo} then 1 else 0 end), 0) num_of7days, count(*) num_oftotal, coalesce(sum(case when study_status = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) num_of_finish from kng_study_record where courseware_id in
#{coursewareId}

select coalesce(sum(case when finish_cost_days <= 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) num_in_one_day, coalesce(sum(case when finish_cost_days between 2 and 7 then 1 else 0 end), 0) num_in_one_week, coalesce(sum(case when finish_cost_days between 8 and 30 then 1 else 0 end), 0) num_in_one_mon, coalesce(sum(case when finish_cost_days between 31 and 90 then 1 else 0 end), 0) num_in_three_mon, coalesce(sum(case when finish_cost_days > 90 then 1 else 0 end), 0) num_in_more_thr_mon from kng_study_record where study_status = 1 and courseware_id in
#{coursewareId}

select
date_format(start_study_time, '%Y-%m') bucket_key,
date_format(date_sub(start_study_time, interval weekday(start_study_time) day), '%Y-%m-%d') bucket_key,
date_format(start_study_time, '%Y-%m-%d') bucket_key,
count(distinct user_id) active_users, coalesce(sum(study_len_hours), 0) active_hours from kng_study_record where start_study_time >= #{from} and start_study_time <= #{to} group by bucket_key

select count(distinct user_id) active_users, count(*) study_visits, coalesce(sum(study_len_hours), 0) study_hours, coalesce(sum(case when study_status = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) finished_visits from kng_study_record where start_study_time >= #{from} and start_study_time <= #{to}
